newsitem.title: JAPAN: SWIMMING-PROGRAMME FOR PAN PACIFIC CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-PROGRAMME FOR PAN PACIFIC CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Programme for the August 10-13 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships (times GMT):

Sunday, August 10 (heats from 0000, finals 0830): Men's 800 metres freestyle. Men's 200 freestyle. Women's 200 freestyle. Men's 100 backstroke. Women's 100 backstroke. Men's 200 butterfly. Women's 200 butterfly. Women's 1,500 freestyle. Men's 25-km open water race. Women's 25-km open water race.

Monday, August 11 (heats 0000, finals 0830): Men's 100 freestyle. Women's 100 freestyle. Men's 100 breaststroke. Women's 100 breaststoke. Men's 400 individual medley. Women's 400 individual medley. Men's 4x200 freestyle relay. Women's 4x200 freestyle relay.

Tuesday, August 12 (heats 0000, finals 0830): Men's 400 freestyle. Women's 400 freestyle. Men's 100 butterfly. Women's 100 butterfly. Men's 200 backstroke. Women's 200 backstroke. Men's 4x100 freestyle relay. Women's 4x100 freestyle relay.

Wednesday, August 13 (heats 0000, finals 0800): Women's 800 freestyle. Men's 200 individual medley. Women's 200 individual medley. Men's 50 freestyle. Women's 50 freestyle. Men's 200 breaststroke. Women's 200 breaststroke. Men's 1,500 freestyle. Men's 4x100 medley relay. Women's 4x100 medley relay.
